name: gusa-quy-trinh
description: Gusa Quy Trinh local OAuth application

scripts.mobile:build: esbuild mobile/push-client.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=mobile/www/push-client.bundle.js && esbuild mobile/native-auth.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=mobile/www/native-auth.bundle.js && esbuild mobile/native-settings.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=mobile/www/native-settings.bundle.js && esbuild web-push.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=web-push.bundle.js && esbuild web-push-service-worker.js --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=firebase-messaging-sw.js
scripts.mobile:add:android: npm run mobile:build && npm run mobile:convert-sounds && cap add android && npm run mobile:copy-sounds
scripts.mobile:add:ios: npm run mobile:build && npm run mobile:convert-sounds && cap add ios && npm run mobile:copy-sounds
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run mobile:build && npm run mobile:convert-sounds && npm run mobile:copy-sounds && cap sync
scripts.mobile:open:android: npm run mobile:sync && cap open android
scripts.mobile:open:ios: npm run mobile:sync && cap open ios
